name: element.toggle
description: Toggle a TogglePattern element (checkbox, switch, toggle button). Returns the new state.

new_state.description: State after the toggle. `indeterminate` is the third state of a tri-state checkbox.

x-implementations.name: uia_toggle
x-implementations.description: UIA `IUIAutomationTogglePattern::Toggle` followed by reading `CurrentToggleState` for the response.

windows-modern.description: TogglePattern.Toggle. Works on standard checkboxes (binary) and tri-state checkboxes (cycles on→indeterminate→off→on). The new_state is the OS-reported value after the toggle; tri-state apps decide the cycle order.
